title: Controller
summary: Pair a Bluetooth game controller and see sticks, triggers and buttons live
description:
Controller pairs a Bluetooth game controller with your CardputerZero and shows its input live.

Pad view: both sticks with their position and recent path, trigger pull in percent, bumpers, d-pad and every button, plus report rate and battery level. Press R to test rumble.

Data view: each axis as a normalised and a raw value, every button, and the controller's ID, address and input node.

Devices view: scan, pair, connect, disconnect and forget controllers, and reset Bluetooth if a connection gets stuck.

The controller stays connected after you close the app, so other programs can use it. The bundled /usr/share/controller/gamepad.py gives Python scripts sticks, triggers and named buttons with no extra dependencies.

Tested with an Xbox One S controller over Bluetooth LE. Written to also handle Xbox Series, PlayStation, Switch Pro, 8BitDo and other HID controllers, which have not been tried yet. Screenshots show the app's demo mode.

Keys: 1-3 or TAB switch views, ENTER selects, S scans, ESC quits.
